fact: In the March 2020 assessment, the DHIS2-EMIS pilot in Gulu and Mayuge districts covered primary and pre-primary schools, whose paper annual census forms were entered at district level, and the pilot recommended piloting online submission by schools.
title: Uganda DHIS2 for EMIS: Pilot in Gulu and Mayuge District, Assessment Report
publisher: Ministry of Education and Sports / HISP Uganda / University of Oslo
